title: Streamwise dispersion with interphase mass transfer through a tube
summary: Reactive solute transport in shear flows is of broad importance in chemical engineering, liquid--solid chromatography, and environmental mechanics, particularly in flow reactors and fluidic devices involving interphase mass transfer. Based on the recently developed streamwise dispersion theory for inert solutions (Guan & Chen, 2024, J. Fluid Mech., vol. 980, A33), we present an analytical model for reactive dispersion of chemically active solutes characterized by first-order, irreversible surface reactions.
